verdict.rationale: The README shows a first-party "Built-in web UI" served by `llama serve`, which gives users a graphical chat interface for local models. That is the product's own capability, not a third-party front-end. The evidence is only a short caption, though, with no detail on the UI's features. Missing for 10: documentation of web UI chat features (conversation management, settings, multimodal input in the UI), independent or hands-on corroboration of the web UI experience.
